_help: What the recommendation systems reward right now, used to steer copy. Update as platforms change; the UI shows the as_of date.

ranking_signals: watch time and completion rate (the first 1-3 s decide most of it)
shares and sends to friends (weighted above likes on every platform)
comments and replies (ask one specific question)
early velocity in the first hour
hook_formulas: Nobody tells you [surprising truth about X]
If you [situation], watch this before you [action]
caption_structure: Line 1 = the hook, under the fold limit, no hashtags
1-2 lines of payoff or context, written for the exact audience
one soft CTA tied to a ranking signal (save, share with someone, comment X)
hashtags on the last line: 1 broad + 2-3 niche + 1 trending/current
title_rules: lead with the keyword people search
specific numbers and outcomes beat adjectives
no clickbait that the clip doesn't pay off
under ~60 characters where a title exists
avoid: the same caption on every platform
trending audio references that don't exist in the clip

youtube_shorts.notes: Shorts search and browse both matter: keyword-first title, #Shorts in title or description, a real description (2-4 lines) with the keywords and a question. Longer-than-60 s Shorts need a strong mid-point hook or completion falls off.
youtube_shorts.hashtags: 3 max, placed in the description; the title gets #Shorts only

instagram_reels.notes: Reels distribution is driven by sends (shares via DM) and saves more than likes. First line of the caption is shown before 'more'. 3-5 hashtags, niche over broad. Trial Reels are an option for testing new formats with non-followers.
instagram_reels.hashtags: 3-5, niche-specific, placed at the end of the caption
instagram_reels.cta: 'Send this to someone who...' or 'Save for later'

tiktok.notes: Search is a major traffic source: put the searchable phrase in the caption and say it out loud in the first seconds. Rewatches and completion dominate. 3-5 hashtags: one broad, the rest exact-niche. Creator Rewards needs 60 s+.
tiktok.hashtags: 3-5, one broad plus exact-niche terms; #fyp adds little but is harmless
tiktok.cta: 'Follow for part 2' or a specific question

facebook_reels.notes: Older, share-heavy audience. Plain language, lead with the payoff, keep hashtags to 1-3. Shares to friends and groups are the main amplifier.
